result.reason: The added insurance provision satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback, including its lower E&O and cyber limits. The unconditional USD 5 million cyber/privacy requirement is sufficient even though the preferred requirement is conditional on processing Customer Data. The clause is confined to insurance, leaves the existing representation-by-counsel language unchanged, and introduces no contradiction or unrelated obligation.
